representative_papers.title: KFTD: Koopman-Fourier Time-Differentiable Network for Continuous Ocean Spatiotemporal Forecasting
representative_papers.problem: Ocean spatiotemporal forecasting must balance nonlinear dynamics with computational cost and continuous-time accuracy.
representative_papers.approach: Map dynamics to linear Koopman space, use Fourier analysis for continuous interpolation, solve via residual networks.
representative_papers.contribution: 5.6% MSE reduction, 76% faster than diffusion methods, maintains physical constraints in latent space.

representative_papers.title: Incident-Guided Spatiotemporal Traffic Forecasting
representative_papers.problem: Traffic forecasting ignores sudden incidents (accidents, weather) that dramatically alter flow patterns unpredictably.
representative_papers.approach: Incident-Guided Spatiotemporal GNN with modules for heterogeneous incident impact and decay dynamics.
representative_papers.contribution: IGSTGNN with incident dataset significantly improves prediction accuracy during anomalous periods.

representative_papers.title: Macro-Micro Collaborative Learning for Logical Data Center Microservice Indicators Forecasting
representative_papers.problem: Microservice indicator forecasting requires modeling both inter-service dependencies and intra-service causal relationships
representative_papers.approach: Macro-micro framework with Indicator-Centric Embedding, heterogeneous graph convolution, and causal sparse attention
representative_papers.contribution: MaMiClif enables accurate LDC microservice forecasting via collaborative macro-micro dependency learning

representative_papers.title: FedRMamba: Federated Residual Mamba for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
representative_papers.problem: Federated forecasting faces heterogeneous variables and temporal correlations.
representative_papers.approach: Residual Mamba blocks: global frequency-aware module plus local patch-wise module with gated fusion.
representative_papers.contribution: Personalized federated framework separates low-frequency and high-frequency patterns.

representative_papers.title: Statistical Analysis of 12V Power Load Uncertainty Using Conditional Probability for SDV Energy Management
representative_papers.problem: Reactive battery systems fail to predict uncertain driver power load patterns.
representative_papers.approach: Conditional probability using past 60 seconds history; LightGBM tracking model.
representative_papers.contribution: Reduces prediction uncertainty variance by 41.7% in high-load regions.

representative_papers.title: Efficient High-Dimensional Time Series Forecasting with Transformers: A Channel Reordering Perspective
representative_papers.problem: High-dimensional time series forecasting has quadratic complexity and entangles local-global dependencies
representative_papers.approach: Channel reordering mechanism with group fusion Transformer separating local and global patterns
representative_papers.contribution: CRAFT model reduces computational complexity and disentangles heterogeneous channel dependencies

representative_papers.title: FedDiG: Frequency-Guided Diffusion Diversity for Generalizable Federated Time Series Classification
representative_papers.problem: Federated time-series classification struggles with source heterogeneity and OOD patterns
representative_papers.approach: Frequency-guided diffusion for diversity generation across clients with cross-frequency sampling
representative_papers.contribution: FedDiG outperforms baselines by synthesizing diverse spectral patterns for improved generalization

representative_papers.title: Is More Context Always Better? Examining LLM Reasoning Capability for Time Interval Prediction
representative_papers.problem: LLM temporal reasoning on structured behavioral data underexplored; unclear if more context improves predictions.
representative_papers.approach: Systematic benchmark of state-of-the-art LLMs on time interval prediction against ML baselines.
representative_papers.contribution: Shows LLMs underperform ML on temporal structure; moderate context helps but excess context degrades performance.

representative_papers.title: Evolving Proxy Kills Drift: Data-Efficient Streaming Time Series Anomaly Detection
representative_papers.problem: Streaming time series anomaly detection with changing distributions; existing methods are static and memory-heavy.
representative_papers.approach: DESS: evolving proxy generation, heterogeneous temporal feature extraction, parameter-efficient training.
representative_papers.contribution: Achieves 17.53% improvement over baselines with 64.88% faster training on streaming anomaly detection.

representative_papers.title: GFMixer: Decoupled Temporal Gradient and Fourier-Aware Attention for Time Series Forecasting
representative_papers.problem: Frequency-domain forecasters suffer from frequency bias and spectral degradation on multivariate time series.
representative_papers.approach: GFMixer: dual-path architecture with Temporal Gradient Block capturing low-amplitude info and Fourier-Aware Attention Block.
representative_papers.contribution: Achieves 37 first-place rankings on seven benchmarks; acts as plug-and-play module enhancing mainstream backbones.

representative_papers.title: Amortized Predictability-aware Training Framework for Time Series Forecasting and Classification
representative_papers.problem: Training instability from low-predictability time series samples affecting forecasting and classification
representative_papers.approach: Hierarchical loss and amortization model to dynamically penalize low-predictability samples during training
representative_papers.contribution: APTF framework improves time series forecasting and classification by focusing on high-predictability samples

representative_papers.title: Cross-city Time Series Forecasting with Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
representative_papers.problem: Cross-city time series forecasting with data sparsity; irrelevant source knowledge hinders target performance
representative_papers.approach: RAG-LLM framework with selective retriever filtering relevant patterns from data-rich cities as structured prompts
representative_papers.contribution: xRAG4TS enables interpretable forecasting in data-scarce cities by selective knowledge transfer from source cities

representative_papers.title: SMART: A Social Movement Analysis & Reasoning Tool with Case Studies on #MeToo and #BlackLivesMatter
representative_papers.problem: Journalists lack timely, actionable insights into social movement discourse around events.
representative_papers.approach: Multi-source collection, emotion extraction, transformer-based emotion forecasting.
representative_papers.contribution: SMART enables early detection of discourse shifts on #MeToo/#BlackLivesMatter around elections.

representative_papers.title: Interpretable Dynamic Network Modeling of Tensor Time Series via Kronecker Time-Varying Graphical Lasso
representative_papers.problem: Tensor time series yield large, uninterpretable dynamic networks; estimation is computationally intensive.
representative_papers.approach: Kronecker product factorization for mode-specific networks with streaming extension.
representative_papers.contribution: KTVGL achieves higher accuracy with lower computation than baselines; scales to stream data.

representative_papers.title: Consensus Stability of Community Notes on X
representative_papers.problem: Community Notes helpful status unstable; rating dynamics after display unclear
representative_papers.approach: Interrupted time series analysis of 35M ratings; study polarization effects
representative_papers.contribution: Shows 30.2% notes lose helpful status; dissimilar raters drive polarization, note disappearance

representative_papers.title: ECLAD: An Edge-Cloud Collaborative Agentic Framework for Interpretable Anomaly Detection in Predictive Maintenance
representative_papers.problem: Anomaly detection in predictive maintenance lacks interpretability; cloud-edge latency tradeoff
representative_papers.approach: Hybrid edge-cloud framework with LLM-based interpretability agents for anomaly reports
representative_papers.contribution: ECLAD provides real-time detection with natural-language explanations and evolving taxonomy

representative_papers.title: FSDI: Frequency-Shaped Diffusion For Time-Series Imputation
representative_papers.problem: Time series imputation in IoT/sensors struggles with spectral energy variance across frequency bins
representative_papers.approach: FSDI replaces uniform variance schedule with data-driven frequency-domain schedule preserving energy
representative_papers.contribution: Frequency-shaped diffusion improves imputation for web analytics, anomaly detection, A/B testing

representative_papers.title: SAMPLE: A Spatial/Channel-wise Attention GCN with MLP and Periodic Linear Encoding for Land Boundary Demarcation System
representative_papers.problem: Manual forecasting and suboptimal task allocation in land boundary demarcation
representative_papers.approach: GCN with periodic linear encoding, spatial-channel attention for web platform prediction
representative_papers.contribution: 88% reduction in time and labor costs via improved field-task scheduling accuracy

representative_papers.title: We Need a More Robust Classifier: Dual Causal Learning Empowers Domain-Incremental Time Series Classification
representative_papers.problem: Time series classifiers struggle with domain incremental learning and robustness
representative_papers.approach: Dual-causal disentanglement framework with intervention mechanism for feature capture
representative_papers.contribution: DualCD framework improves domain-incremental robustness by separating causal and spurious features

representative_papers.title: Dynamic Multi-period Experts for Online Time Series Forecasting
representative_papers.problem: Online time series forecasting treats concept drift monolithically; misses recurring vs. emergent
representative_papers.approach: Dynamic multi-period experts: specialized committee for recurring drift, general expert for emergent
representative_papers.contribution: DynaME outperforms baselines by explicitly modeling dual drift types

representative_papers.title: TimeMar: Multi-Scale Autoregressive Modeling for Unconditional Time Series Generation
representative_papers.problem: Time series generation ignores multi-scale patterns and structural heterogeneity (trend/seasonal)
representative_papers.approach: Multi-scale autoregressive with dual-path VQ-VAE for trend-seasonal disentanglement
representative_papers.contribution: TimeMAR generates higher-quality long-term sequences with reduced parameters

representative_papers.title: Modeling Point-to-Point Dependency for High-Dimensional Long-Term Series Forecasting
representative_papers.problem: Modeling point-to-point dependencies across dimensions; Transformer complexity O(N²) prevents efficient forecasting
representative_papers.approach: Replace Self-Attention with global autocorrelation; Spectral Product Mechanism reduces complexity to O(N)
representative_papers.contribution: O(N) complexity with global dependency modeling; outperforms transformers on high-dimensional long-term forecasting

representative_papers.title: ImVision: Adapting Pretrained Vision Models for Time-Series Imputation
representative_papers.problem: Missing values harm reliability; existing imputers computationally demanding and disrupt temporal order
representative_papers.approach: Reframe imputation as image inpainting; convert sequences to Gramian Angular Field heatmaps; use pretrained vision
representative_papers.contribution: Cross-modal efficiency; outperforms SOTAs on 8/10 settings; especially strong at high missing rates

representative_papers.title: EEO-TFV: Escape-Explore Optimizer for Web-Scale Time-Series Forecasting and Vision Analysis
representative_papers.problem: Transformer models suffer error accumulation in long sequences and fail on out-of-distribution web data
representative_papers.approach: Lightweight Transformer with Escape-Explore optimizer avoiding sharp minima and saddle points
representative_papers.contribution: Matched state-of-the-art performance across time-series and medical image tasks with better generalization

representative_papers.title: Time-TK: A Multi-Offset Temporal Interaction Framework Combining Transformer and Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Time Series Forecasting
representative_papers.problem: Token embedding destroys multi-offset temporal correlations in time series forecasting
representative_papers.approach: Multi-Offset Time Embedding with KAN-based architecture capturing fine-grained dependencies
representative_papers.contribution: Fundamentally addresses information bottleneck in long sequence processing

representative_papers.title: Energy-Efficient Training-Free Zero-Inflation Correction for Rainfall Forecasting with Time-Series Foundation Models
representative_papers.problem: Time-series foundation models fail on zero-inflated rainfall due to continuous outputs
representative_papers.approach: Training-free wrapper: empirical statistics, probability transforms, Pareto tail mapping
representative_papers.contribution: Corrects zero inflation without retraining; <5ms overhead, carbon-neutral deployment

representative_papers.title: Automated Model Selection for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
representative_papers.problem: MTSF model selection requires expensive training; no comprehensive dataset or scalable selection method
representative_papers.approach: Transforms MTSF selection into classification using large model encodings and recursive temporal patterns
representative_papers.contribution: AutoMTSF and ModelPile dataset enable efficient model selection across 41 datasets without extensive training

representative_papers.title: Scalable Anomaly Detection for Temporal Web Streams via Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
representative_papers.problem: Temporal Web streams require scalable anomaly detection handling high-dimensionality and imbalanced data
representative_papers.approach: Hierarchical ANN index with statistical neighbor scoring and adaptive update for concept drift
representative_papers.contribution: ANN-TS achieves superior accuracy on imbalanced high-dimensional data with reduced computational overhead

representative_papers.title: Enhancing Large Language Models for Time-Series Forecasting via Vector-Injected In-Context Learning
representative_papers.problem: LLMs struggle with time-series forecasting due to domain mismatch between pretraining and TSF; fine-tuning adds computational overhead.
representative_papers.approach: Vector-injected in-context learning (LVICL) injects learnable context vectors into frozen LLM layers to extract and apply example information.
representative_papers.contribution: Improves LLM time-series forecasting performance without parameter fine-tuning, reducing computational overhead.

representative_papers.title: SEMixer: Semantics Enhanced MLP-Mixer for Multiscale Mixing and Long-term Time Series Forecasting
representative_papers.problem: Multiscale patterns and semantic gaps hinder efficient time series forecasting
representative_papers.approach: Random Attention Mechanism and Multiscale Progressive Mixing Chain in MLP-Mixer
representative_papers.contribution: Lightweight model achieving third place on 21GB real wireless network forecasting challenge

representative_papers.title: Re-Diffusion: Modeling Latent Residuals with Diffusion for Time-Series Forecasting
representative_papers.problem: Diffusion models underperform on time-series forecasting with long-term prediction challenges
representative_papers.approach: Latent diffusion generating backbone residuals to model error distributions
representative_papers.contribution: 10% improvement over state-of-art predictors through advanced residual estimation

representative_papers.title: Temporal-Series-Aware Adaptive Positional Encoding for Transformer-based Sequential Recommendation
representative_papers.problem: Transformers rely on absolute position encoding insufficient for sequential recommendation capturing user interest evolution
representative_papers.approach: Adaptive positional encoding modeling time intervals between interactions with CNN and attention mechanisms
representative_papers.contribution: TSAPE integrates temporal-series awareness with conventional PE for improved sequential recommendation

representative_papers.title: DynaFLUX: Implicit Dynamics-Preserving Reinforcement Learning for Topology-Free Influence Maximization
representative_papers.problem: Influence maximization fails without network topology due to hidden, noisy or privacy-protected links
representative_papers.approach: End-to-end generative framework learning latent dynamics from time series with RL seed selection policy
representative_papers.contribution: DynaFLUX identifies influential spreaders using self-attention pointer and Monte Carlo diffusion rewards

representative_papers.title: Shift-Resilient Diffusive Imputation for Variable Subset Forecasting
representative_papers.problem: Variable subset forecasting fails with distribution shift in incomplete time series
representative_papers.approach: Divide-conquer decomposition into invariant and variant patterns for imputation
representative_papers.contribution: SRDI handles inter-series and intra-series shift in variable subset forecasting

representative_papers.title: LLM-GC: Advancing Granger Causal Discovery from Time Series with Multimodel Language Modeling
representative_papers.problem: Granger causal discovery confined to raw time-series lacking contextual semantics and prone to overfitting
representative_papers.approach: LLM-GC multimodal framework enriching temporal dynamics with semantic priors via cross-modal dual retrieval and shared causality augmenter
representative_papers.contribution: First LLM-empowered Granger causality discovery outperforming state-of-the-art on synthetic and real-world benchmark datasets

representative_papers.title: N41: Leveraging One Target and Neighboring Features to Improve Anomaly Detection Accuracy
representative_papers.problem: Multivariate time-series anomaly detection distributes error across multiple outputs reducing focus
representative_papers.approach: Single target feature with neighboring features capturing similar patterns for focused learning
representative_papers.contribution: N41 achieves 1.7-7.5x higher F1 scores via single-target focused training on time-series

representative_papers.title: A Comprehensive Guide to Time-Series Anomaly Detection
representative_papers.problem: Time series anomaly detection lacks comprehensive benchmarking and evaluation methods
representative_papers.approach: Holistic tutorial covering algorithms, benchmarks, evaluation, and foundation models
representative_papers.contribution: Interactive systems for method exploration, new taxonomy, benchmarking advancements survey

representative_papers.title: Spectral Modeling of Periodic Phenomena in Scientific Data via Fourier–Galerkin Representation
representative_papers.problem: Modeling periodic phenomena in large-scale heterogeneous scientific datasets with phase shifts and misalignment
representative_papers.approach: Fourier-Galerkin regression decomposing time series into trend and periodic residual with phase offsets
representative_papers.contribution: FG-Linear model captures periodic behavior effectively with improved interpretability over deep learning baselines

representative_papers.title: Confounder-Aware Causal Graph Learning Framework for Multivariate Time Series Analysis
representative_papers.problem: Existing causal graph methods lack handling of unobserved confounders and dynamic relationships in MTS
representative_papers.approach: Multi-granularity causal architecture with VAE-based confounder proxies and confounding bias index
representative_papers.contribution: CACGL framework models unobserved confounders and time-varying causality in multivariate time series

representative_papers.title: MANILA26: SIGIR 2026 Tutorial on Information Retrieval for Climate Change Impact
representative_papers.problem: IR systems fail on interdisciplinary climate evidence synthesis with geospatial, time-series, multi-modal data.
representative_papers.approach: Agentic RAG architecture critique; failure mode diagnosis; unified evidence pipeline with provenance tracking.
representative_papers.contribution: Research agenda for verifiable evidence synthesis integrating bibliographic, geospatial, multi-modal retrieval.
